historical_exact_pair.LCDM_stationarity_semantics: accepted-score point is not Hessian-certified; the historical positive-definite Hessian belonged to a neighboring point one Ob base step away
historical_exact_pair.RTK_stationarity_semantics: accepted score, base Hessian center and half Hessian center coincide exactly; final base and half are recenter-clear and PD

superseded_t1_seed.old_half_policy: Any scale-0.5 result already launched at this t=1 center is historical diagnostic only and cannot authorize paired replay.

active_forward_gate.decision_rule: If improvement beyond t=1.1 exceeds 0.005, recenter at best sampled point; if best lies on upper boundary, preregister another extension. Only after forward direction is recenter-clear may a full Hessian be built at the exact current center.

rtk_cross_basin_status.interpretation: No tested B9 RTK neighborhood point supersedes the historical RTK reference; this does not exclude another RTK basin elsewhere.

A5_global_state_policy: Do not overwrite research/state/current.json accepted pair until the current best-known LCDM point passes exact recenter/stationarity and independent fresh-tree replay, followed by a common paired replay.
A6_policy: Do not refresh model-selection statistics until A5 is re-frozen under a new separately declared protocol.
guard: No global minimum, sigma/Wilks, posterior, AIC/BIC or Bayes claim follows from this navigation state.
